column1: # tests/memfn/pins/arms.tsv -- C5's per-arm pins ([MEMFN] R4c; integration.md
# §17.4): the sha256 of each scalar arm's rendering of each fixture site
# A CHANGE DETECTOR (§17.4 [rev4.2]): a kit change that moves an arm's text
# re-pins that arm's rows IN ITS OWN COMMIT, with its abi event (D76/D94: this
# file is a reader of the emitted text, found by grep). Recorded at R4c's
# IMPLEMENT commit, whose I1 shadow comparator proved the kit's rendering of
# every corpus compile equal to pcrec's pre-migration text. RE-PINNED at M1b's
# REPLACE (lane m1b): the fixtures' stand-in `run_cmp` hook is retired, so the
# run-bearing fixtures render the kit's own run compare and their word-load
# helpers (whose text M1b's I1 comparator proved equal to pcrec's over the
# corpus); the `runcmp` arm's fixtures are new. No artifact byte moved.
# m1bfix ADDED (no row re-pinned): ofs-miss-n (ofsskip, a miss stated as
# the `n` hook's text) and the two DECLINE fixtures ofs-decline-miss and
# ofs-decline-floor, pinned to `generic`: the offset-skip function returns
# `n` and reads from `pos` up, so a site with another miss or a stated floor
# is the generic row's. A row that falls back to ofsskip is check 1's red.
# missn ADDED (no row re-pinned): ofs-miss-token and pre-lead-handoff-miss-token,
# the sites of ofs-miss-n and pre-lead-handoff with `miss` stated by the
# MF_MISS_N token; each pins the SAME digests as its text-stated twin (the
# token renders as the `n` hook's text, never its own bytes).
# Columns (tab-separated): arm (the kit's form id), fixture, part (`def` the
# file-scope text, `use` the entry's), bytes, sha256.
